title: The Unwritten Orchard
author: Lena Eriksen
blurb: Ansel Eastwick, a pearl diver's child indentured to a trading company, keeps a low profile and busy hands. Then the bridge — the only road out — closes for the season — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must choose which family member gets the last berth before the century turns.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
